Name: Nyapu Style Coal Farm
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]YAY! It's finished. This one took some doing. Especially Liitle Issac and his overlays. I took some artistic liberties with some of the portraits. I wasn't completely sure what Ashida's hair was supposed to look like... so I guess I added a decorative bun. I really like how they all turned out tbh. I tried my best to match each expression to the dialogue I found, but there were some that I had to guess on. [/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]Okay, everyone. I am not completely confident with my CP code this time around. I tried to make sense of  [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/76795413]AndrewJamesC[/url] [/i]code and tried my best to make my own CP Portrait file... but I am not sure that it will work bug-free. You might need to use the manual replacement file because I wasn't able to test several of the portrait overlays. If you do find any issues, let me know, and I'll pray to the coding gods that I'll be able to figure out how to fix it. LOL. [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][Main File] CP is just a drag and drop into your mods folder, and you're ready to go. ( I hope)

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. (Kind of suggest using this one since I am not confident in my code this time.)
You should get a prompt to replace the original files if you do it right.
If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page. [/color]


[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][i]BIG thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for letting me use their art as a base. 
The BIGGEST thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1249127]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url] for teaching me how to code. [/i][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][i]Thank you  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/76795413]AndrewJamesC[/url] for letting me retexture your mod.[/i][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][i]Thank you earthtosyd for giving me your living portrait frame edit.  [/i][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][i][b]What am I working on?:
[/b]If you're curious what I am working on next, please check out my social media page or my Nexus profile. [/i][/color]
